# One wire settling two invoices and leaving 30.00 over.
#
# `Assets:Bank:USD +180.00` against four receivable splits: −60.00 and −40.00
# settling one invoice between them, −50.00 settling another, and −30.00 left
# over.
#
# The shape exists to be *unposted* afterwards. Unposting the second invoice
# leaves its −50.00 loose and marked as this tool's own orphan — which the
# writer of a `prepayment:` line skips, an orphan being a settlement waiting to
# be put back rather than money left over. A reader that counts it makes 80.00
# of a 30.00 residue and refuses the export that wrote it.
#
# What this fixture produces: a USD transaction with five splits, four on the
# receivable and none in a lot.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
2026-03-28 * "Money in, two invoices and a small residue"
	guid: "5150aabb5150ccdd5150eeff51500011"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 180.00 USD
		guid: "5150aabb5150ccdd5150eeff51500022"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable USD -60.00 USD
		guid: "5150aabb5150ccdd5150eeff51500033"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable USD -40.00 USD
		guid: "5150aabb5150ccdd5150eeff51500044"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable USD -50.00 USD
		guid: "5150aabb5150ccdd5150eeff51500055"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable USD -30.00 USD
		guid: "5150aabb5150ccdd5150eeff51500066"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
